title: Young Boy Holding Newborn Baby Sister in Armchair, 1950s Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
Lona Anne was born May 15th; weighed 6 lb. 14 oz.; was 21 inches long.

678 F

Ida, Jack, and Larry Shepley
description: An intimate domestic portrait showing a young toddler named Larry sitting carefully in a dark patterned upholstered armchair, proudly holding his newborn sister, Lona Anne, who is swaddled in blankets. In the background of the living room, a vintage floor lamp with a flared shade and a wooden cabinet are visible against a light wall. A handwritten caption on the front margin identifies the siblings, while the back records Lona Anne's birth date and measurements along with the names of family members Ida, Jack, and Larry Shepley, reflecting post-WWII American family documentation.
